name: Claude Bridge
description: Lets Claude build and test levels in the editor via a local bridge (127.0.0.1).

server-enabled.name: AI Server
server-enabled.description: Allow Claude to control the game through the local bridge (127.0.0.1 only).

port.name: Port
port.description: TCP port of the bridge. <cy>Restart the game</c> after changing.

read-only.name: Read-only mode
read-only.description: Claude can read levels and run the bot, but cannot change or save anything.

auto-backup.name: Backup before AI edits
auto-backup.description: Save a copy of the level before the first AI change in each editor session (mod save folder / backups).

auto-start.name: Start Claude on Send
auto-start.description: Pressing <cg>Send to Claude</c> immediately starts Claude in the background (no chat needed). Progress is shown in the Claude panel; <cr>Stop AI</c> cancels.

claude-command.name: Start command
claude-command.description: Command line that starts the Claude run (hidden window).

project-dir.name: Project folder
project-dir.description: Working folder for the start command (Claude project with CLAUDE.md and tools).

notifications.name: AI notifications
notifications.description: Show a small notification when Claude adds, removes or changes objects.

editor-button.name: AI button in editor
editor-button.description: Show the AI button (Claude panel) in the level editor.

block-autopause.name: No auto-pause in bot runs
block-autopause.description: Do not pause the level when the window loses focus while Claude's bot is playing.
